launch.name: ctx-size
launch.description: Context for the block text and the image embeddings; the decision model reads the state and the image in one pass.

blockPrompts.text:
Block type: text.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order with the image.
The block is running text and may begin or end in the middle of a sentence.
blockPrompts.title:
Block type: title or heading.
Compare the words, numbers, capitalization and punctuation of the heading text.
A heading marker or numbering the OCR added in front of it is not part of the content.
blockPrompts.table:
Block type: table.
Compare the text, numbers, signs and labels in every cell, and check that each cell sits in the same row and column as in the image.
Row order, column order, empty cells and merged cells count; the HTML tags and their attributes do not.
blockPrompts.equation:
Block type: mathematical formula.
Compare the formula the recognized text denotes with the formula printed in the image: symbols, subscripts, superscripts, fractions, radicals, operators, brackets, accents and the equation number.
A bound missing or added on a sum, product or integral, a subscript attached to a different base, a letter in the wrong alphabet, or a numerator and denominator in the wrong order counts as a difference.
How the formula is written as code does not count.
blockPrompts.formula:
Block type: mathematical formula.
Compare the formula the recognized text denotes with the formula printed in the image: symbols, subscripts, superscripts, fractions, radicals, operators, brackets, accents and the equation number.
A bound missing or added on a sum, product or integral, a subscript attached to a different base, a letter in the wrong alphabet, or a numerator and denominator in the wrong order counts as a difference.
How the formula is written as code does not count.
blockPrompts.list:
Block type: list.
Compare item text, markers, indentation and item order.
blockPrompts.code:
Block type: source code.
Compare identifiers, keywords, strings, numbers, punctuation and indentation.
blockPrompts.abstract:
Block type: abstract or summary.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order.
blockPrompts.image_caption:
Block type: figure caption.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order.
blockPrompts.table_caption:
Block type: table caption.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order.
blockPrompts.figure_footnote:
Block type: figure footnote.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order.
blockPrompts.table_footnote:
Block type: table footnote.
Compare words, numbers, punctuation and word order.
blockPrompts.ref_text:
Block type: bibliography or reference entry.
Compare author names, years, titles, volume, issue, pages and punctuation.
blockPrompts.reference:
Block type: bibliography or reference entry.
Compare author names, years, titles, volume, issue, pages and punctuation.
blockPrompts.header:
Block type: running header.
Compare letters, numbers, punctuation and capitalization.
blockPrompts.footer:
Block type: running footer.
Compare letters, numbers, punctuation and capitalization.
blockPrompts.page_number:
Block type: page number.
Compare every digit and the numbering style: digits, roman numerals or letters.
A digit that is not readable in the crop counts as a difference.
blockPrompts.seal:
Block type: seal or stamp text.
Compare only the words readable in the crop; decoration and illegible edges do not count.
Words the recognized text contains but the crop does not show count as a difference.
